spec.name: Amezri Village
spec.description: A small village in the High Atlas, located in a valley over 2,000 meters above sea level along the Oued Tassaout river. It serves as a hub for nearby villages and hosts a weekly souk every Tuesday.
comments: Trasportation from Ouarzazate: Taxi to Imghrane Toundoute -> Transit van to Amezri.
Locals are kind but conservative. Make sure to respect the people and their traditions.
Accomodation: You can camp around the village, local gites and guest houses are available for daily rent.
